title: Sign in with Google
description:
As a student, I want to sign in with my Google account, so that I can reach the IDE from any device.

Feature: Google sign-in
  Scenario: An approved student signs in
    Given the Google account student@example.com is on the allowlist
    When the student chooses Sign in with Google and completes consent
    Then the IDE opens signed in as that account
    And the control endpoint accepts the resulting token

  Scenario: An unapproved account is refused
    Given the Google account stranger@example.com is not on the allowlist
    When that account tries to sign in
    Then sign-in is refused with a message explaining access is by invitation

  Scenario: Signing out
    Given a signed-in student
    When they choose Sign out
    Then the token is discarded and the IDE shows the sign-in screen
right_now_summary: Google sign-in scenarios are defined, but no implementation activity has been recorded.
